binder_system: typically Ni-Fe or Ni-Cu depending on grade
manufacturing: Liquid-phase sintering / powder-metallurgy route; machining and finishing are grade dependent.
machinability: difficult but generally more machinable than monolithic tungsten
fracture_behaviour: Tungsten particles provide stiffness/density while binder phase provides ductility; defects and binder continuity strongly affect fracture.
